definitions.explanation: Being inspired or stimulated by something external to take action or have new ideas.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{言葉|ことば}に{触発|しょくはつ}された。
examples.english: I was inspired by his words.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}に{触発|しょくはつ}されて{小説|しょうせつ}を{書|か}き{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: Inspired by this movie, I started writing a novel.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}の{成功|せいこう}に{触発|しょくはつ}されて{起業|きぎょう}を{決意|けつい}した。
examples.english: Inspired by my friend's success, I decided to start a business.

notes:
{触発|しょくはつ} emphasizes external stimulus.

USAGE:
- Often passive: ～に{触発|しょくはつ}される (to be inspired by)
- Implies that something external prompts action or ideas

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～に{触発|しょくはつ}される: to be inspired/triggered by
- ～に{触発|しょくはつ}されて: inspired by (doing something)
- {触発|しょくはつ}を{受|う}ける: to receive inspiration

CONTRAST:
- {触発|しょくはつ}: emphasizes external trigger
- {刺激|しげき}: stimulation (more general)
- {インスピレーション}: inspiration (loanword, more artistic)
